story: Stephon Castle's steal and Julian Champagnie's three with 7:55 left made it 105–97. The Spurs won 124–112, two nights after their 12-game streak ended.
aria: Animated Short: Julian Champagnie's 3-pointer off a Stephon Castle steal with 7:55 left that made it 105–97 Spurs. San Antonio beats the Clippers 124–112 at home. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
